scope: Theorem 10.9 (Uniform numerical interface) of the manuscript “Exact derandomization of logarithmic space: L = RL = BPL” (preprints/Exact-Derandomization-of-Logarithmic-Space-L-equals-RL-equals-BPL-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 103 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 15030fab23d31a4d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 72. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix the digit alphabet, positive reciprocal intervals, and constants bounding the following recipe class. A recipe at slack d ≥ 1 has a fixed number of stages built from bounded arithmetic operations, fixed piecewise formulas using maxima, minima and clipping, the reciprocals of Lemma 10.5, indexed ranks as in Lemma 10.6, and sums and known scales as in Lemma 10.7. The stage and descriptor descriptions are generated from the root parameters by index computations using O(B + d + t) scratch and no operand queries, and the total non-reduction dependency depth is bounded independently of d. Each indexed domain has size 2O(d) and descriptors of length O(d). Discrete domain and validity decisions are structural leaves or buffered tests with their own fixed precision conventions. Public coefficient leaves have exact normalized digit procedures using O(B + d + t) shared scratch and making no operand or recursive graph queries. Then each normalized recipe value has a deterministic exact A-stream. For its digit at clock t there are uniform constants a, b, c such that every requested operand digit j satisfies j ≤ t + cd, total suspended local binary record length ≤ ad + b(t − j). (10.18) An output code bit satisfies the same bounds. A structural leaf is requested at clock zero and has suspended local length at most ad + bt. The maximum intrinsic local record length is O(d + t). All gate, digit and descriptor addresses can be regenerated from root parameters and the saved local records using O(B + d + t) shared scratch and no recursive graph calls. When d, t = O(B) this is O(B) scratch. If a public rational coefficient has O(B)-bit numerator and denominator that can be generated in O(B) scratch, its queried digits in this clock range also require only that shared O(B) scratch.
